name: Jai Mata Glass Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1981, Jai Mata Glass Ltd is in the business of interior and exterior designer glasses.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
JMGL is engaged in the business of trading
 in glass and procuring orders as a sales agent 
in the eastern and northern regions of India. Currently, the company’s revenue comprises solely of commission income.

pros: Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 327 days to 76.4 days
cons: Stock is trading at 8.51 times its book value
Company has a low return on equity of -1.90% over last 3 years.
